system.description:
Ugly Truth is the singular ability to strip a situation or argument to its bare, naked core.

Obstacles: Stating the obvious worst possible outcome, Ob 1. Ugly truth about family, Ob 2. Ugly truth about your friends, Ob 3. Ugly truth about a complex political situation, Ob 4. Ugly truth about a nuanced or delicate situation, Ob 5. Ugly Truth can also be used in the Duel of Wits.

FoRKs: Falsehood, Intimidation

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 306
